# CiteReady — AI Search (llms.txt / GEO), Crawler & Schema.org Technical SEO Kit

> Make your startup docs, landing pages, and SaaS site effortless for ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews to crawl and cite.

- llms.txt & JSON-LD GitHub Action CI Guide: https://zcoldwater.github.io/citeready-cli/llms-txt-github-action-guide.html
- Free Live Web Diagnostic: https://citeready-checker.appwrite.network
- Open-Source Lite CLI & Composite GitHub Action (`uses: zColdWater/citeready-cli@v1`, MIT, zero dependencies): https://github.com/zColdWater/citeready-cli
- CiteReady Pro ($19 Solo / $39 Agency — Sitemap-to-llms.txt compiler, Schema.org JSON-LD generator, local GEO workbench, CI gate & white-label client PDF/HTML reports): https://omnipulse-x402.appwrite.network/go/gumroad/citeready

## Quick CLI & GitHub Action Usage

```bash
npx github:zColdWater/citeready-cli check https://stripe.com
npx github:zColdWater/citeready-cli check https://yoursite.com --min-score 75 --require-llms-txt --require-jsonld
```

```yaml
- uses: zColdWater/citeready-cli@v1
  with:
    url: https://yoursite.com
    min-score: "75"
    require-llms-txt: "true"
    require-jsonld: "true"
```
